propositions: The copied legacy Pandoc subprocess oracle is coupled to mutable production constants (_PANDOC_TO) and shares generated outputs rather than pinning independent expectations, allowing mutations to pass both oracle branches identically.

Replacing 884 redundant legacy subprocess calls with immutable expected-output fixtures eliminates 884 Pandoc invocations while preserving all 884 real production _convert/Pandoc calls per per-change run.

The fixture schema must record exact generating Pandoc version and SHA-256 binary fingerprints for all supported platforms (darwin-arm64, linux-x86_64) and reject version drift and platform/binary mismatches at gate time.
Deterministic fixture regeneration requires a documented runnable generator that validates generating-binary provenance and preserves the complete platform fingerprint map.
